_doc: Local fame (systems/fame.js): how the people of one realm see the player. good = renown*renownWeight + max(0,rep)*repWeight + max(0,karma)*karmaWeight + House honours; ill = max(0,-rep)*badRepWeight + max(0,-karma)*badKarmaWeight + heat*heatWeight. An ill-fame stage applies when ill reaches its threshold and is at least the good score.

stages.label: Stranger
stages.blurb: No one here knows your name.

stages.label: Known
stages.blurb: Folk here have heard of you.

stages.label: Celebrated
stages.blurb: Your name is toasted here. Innkeepers stand you a meal and a bed; crowds gather when you ride in.

stages.label: Legend
stages.blurb: Songs are sung of you here. Every door is open; people press gifts and petitions on you.

stages.label: Distrusted
stages.blurb: Folk here have heard of you, and none of it good. Traders pad their prices; the watch takes a bigger bribe.

stages.label: Shunned
stages.blurb: Doors close as you pass. Guards shadow you through the streets and every bribe costs dear.

celebrated: A small crowd gathers to see you ride into {town}. Someone starts a cheer.
Children run ahead of you through {town}, shouting your name.
legend: {town} turns out to see you: the streets are lined, and a minstrel strikes up a song about you.
Bells ring as you enter {town}. Folk press close just to touch your cloak.

giftLines: An old woman presses {gold} gold into your hand: 'For luck, and for what you did.'
A merchant insists you take {gold} gold. 'It's an honour,' he says, and will hear no refusal.
shadowLines: Two guards fall in behind you as you enter {town}, and do not leave.
The watch at {town} marks you at the gate. A guard trails you through the streets.

known: I know that face. You're {player}, aren't you?
{player}! I've heard your name in the tavern.
celebrated: Is it really {player}? Wait till I tell my sister!
Everyone in {town} talks of you, {player}. Welcome, welcome!
legend: *goes down on one knee* {player}... I never thought I'd see you with my own eyes.
They sing of you in every hall in {kingdom}, {player}. What brings a legend to {town}?
distrusted: *eyes you warily* I've heard about you, {player}.
Keep your hands where I can see them, {player}. I know your sort.
shunned: Get away from me. Everyone knows what you are.

rivalSeed._doc: In a realm ruled by a rival House, townsfolk start colder by feud*perFeud (to -max), and speak of the feud.

requests._doc: The famous are asked for help (systems/fame.js townRequest): arriving in a town where the crowd gathers, a celebrated/legendary player is begged for a favour with chance[stage], at most once per cooldownDays anywhere and townCooldownDays per town, with no more than maxOpen such favours open. The asker is a real townsperson (settlement.folk) where there is one. Each hook is a quest hook for Quests.createNpcTask (type: a Quests.NPC_TASK_OBJECTIVES key; task: a data/npcTasks.json task; reward: a Quests.NPC_TASK_REWARDS kind). Drawn on its own seeded stream. lines: the lead-in ({who}, {town}, {player}, {stage}).

hooks.text: Outlaws took my grandmother's locket on the road. They say nothing is beyond you. Please, get it back.
My boy went into the old forest after a dare and never came out. If anyone can find him, it is you.
A pack has been at our flocks every night. The watch shrugs. You would not.
Our shrine's relic was stolen and carried into the ruins. The priest says only a hero would dare.
A caravan of ours vanished on the road. We pooled what we have: find it, great one.
There is a bandit camp in the woods and the lord will not send men. Will you?
The old hermit in the hills needs his medicine and the road is not safe for us. You fear nothing, they say.

lines: {who} pushes through the crowd and falls to one knee: the tales of you reached {town} long before you did.
Before the cheering has died, {who} catches your sleeve: "You are {player}? Then you can help us."
{who} has waited at the gate all morning for a glimpse of you, and will not let you pass without a plea.
